invalid_failure_risks: The --help flag explicitly documents 'column-major since v2.0' per the internal hint, making the harder bug trivially discoverable and collapsing the task to a ~12-command speedrun
The partial cancellation on uniform data is a nice property but doesn't prevent an agent from finding both bugs independently via --help + source reading in a single pass

The 5% relative error threshold may be sensitive to sketch width/depth/seed parameters not fully specified in the blueprint, potentially making the threshold flaky depending on exact sketch configuration
Off-by-one in column-major indexing (i*depth+j vs j*width+i) is listed as a trap but the correct formula is standard and any engineer familiar with matrix layout would get it right immediately
The verifier's numpy.percentile ground truth vs sketch estimate comparison could be flaky at boundary cases (e.g., exactly 5.0% error) without a specified tolerance buffer
review.reasons: The task fails the genuine_difficulty threshold (scores 2) because the --help flag explicitly documents the column-major format change, making both bugs discoverable in under 12 commands via straightforward source reading plus one binary probe. The 'interacting bugs that are NOT visible by reading source alone' claim in the internal hint is undermined by the --help documentation, which a competent agent will check immediately. The clever partial-cancellation property doesn't add difficulty once both bugs are independently findable. The average score (3.8) is acceptable but genuine_difficulty at 2 triggers rejection.
fixes: Remove the --help documentation of 'column-major since v2.0' from the agg binary; instead make the format discoverable only by feeding known values and inspecting the blob bytes, requiring the agent to write a probe script and reason about byte layout

Remove or obfuscate the correction factor comment in sketch.go so it doesn't read as obviously suspicious; make it look like intentional normalization that requires understanding the full pipeline to identify as wrong

Add a third subtle bug (e.g., an off-by-one in the sliding window boundary that only manifests on bimodal distributions) to raise the number of required discoveries and increase the chance that a partial fix fails
Make the uniform test cancellation more fragile by using a slightly skewed 'uniform' distribution so agents cannot rely on go test ./... as a reliable partial-correctness signal
